description: Bring your family for a little ice cream treat sponsored by Browndog Barlor. Meet Lisa McIntyre, candidate for state Representative for HD22 - western Livonia. Building community one treat at a time! I can't wait to hear what is on your mind when you look ahead to November and beyond.
